name: Igoudar Numerique / Igoudar Dakhla green datacenter campus
developer: Moroccan Ministry of Digital Transition and Administrative Reform (MMSP/MTNRA); Ministry of Energy Transition and Sustainable Development; Dakhla-Oued Eddahab regional authorities; Mohammed VI Investment Fund; Caisse de depot et de gestion (CDG)
notes: Planned next-generation green datacenter campus in Dakhla (Dakhla-Oued Eddahab, Moroccan-administered part of disputed Western Sahara) with a target capacity of 500 MW. Official ministry announcement (Apr 2026) reports a convention to operationalise the Igoudar Numerique campus and launch strategic studies following 2025 agreements; Medias24/W.Media/Telquel corroborate the 500 MW target and AI/HPC positioning. Status remains 'planned / studies launched' per A-grade official source - not under construction or operational. 500 MW is target capacity, not committed IT load.
